reviews.text: I worked with Patricia on my dog's behaviour. Patricia is knowledgeable, and seems to have real-world experience which I think is important.  She actively encourages feedback, adjusting the training plan based on what was and wasn't working. She also assisted in getting a veterinary follow-up on some signs of discomfort I'd noticed. My dog's behaviours had been practised for a long time, so Patricia managed expectations that progress will be slower to start with, but I'm definitely seeing huge improvements.  The only thing worth mentioning, for the benefit of others, is that I was looking for a in-person trainer and I hadn’t appreciated that this was predominantly virtual.

Pat and her team are incredible. I've owned and trained dogs most of my life and thought I knew a thing or two. However the knowledge and intuition from Pat is gold standard. I was stuck with what to do and everything I tried wasn't working to help my rescue dog. We still have a way to go but have been armed with very useful ongoing tools from Pat. I highly recommend anyone who needs support and to understand their dog that they reach out to Pat and Helen. The support is fantastic!

Patricia has been amazing in helping our dog with his separation anxiety training! She also helped pointed out some issues with our dogs rear legs during the sessions. We highly recommend working with her!

Have been working with Patricia for the last few months on my dog’s behaviour and separation anxiety. We started by addressing health-related issues that could have been affecting my dog’s behaviour following a long questionnaire and consultation.

First, Patricia informed us about his bowels, so we switched to a hypoallergenic food. After switching his food, I’ve noticed a massive improvement in my dog’s bowel movements. Additionally, Patricia noticed that when he went downstairs, my dog may have been in pain because of how he held himself, as well as the answers I provided in the questionnaire and our consultation (e.g., my dog reacting to roller bladers, skateboards, scooters, runners, sirens, motorbikes, etc. – anything that would cause him to jump). Because of this, she helped advocate with my vet for a trial of pain medication for my dog, and we noticed improvements in his behaviour afterwards. For example, we can now walk past things that would have previously made him jump and bark. I no longer worry about runners/joggers going past us on a walk, as he will look at them and then go back to what he’s doing.

Since we have managed to manage these behaviours, we’ve now moved on to his separation anxiety. When I moved places, it became difficult to leave my dog without him getting anxious. We’ve worked with Patricia on this for the last couple of months, with a weekly session where we review how the training has been going, practice it in the session to show her, and then she adjusts based on what she sees my dog exhibiting.

Patricia and Helen are both very responsive and accommodating where possible. It’s been a pleasure working with them, and I will continue to work with them to really nail my dog’s separation anxiety.

I reached out to Positive Dog London because my dog Rex (cute chihuahua) is very reactive to big dogs and children. I had tried many things before and his behaviour didn't seem to improve. Since working with Pat, Rex's behaviour has improved so much and I am feeling relieved that his issues are being taken care of in a holistic manner, looking at training but also underlying health issues. Pat has been thorough in her review and examination of Rex. I received a very detailed plan for him but it has not been overwhelming to put it in practice. She is very responsive and attentive and it has been a pleasure to work with her and see Rex get better every day. Can't recommend their services enough!

Working with Patricia has been invaluable in helping us to better understand our rescue dog, Alfie, who was previously reactive to other dogs and could be grumpy and unpredictable in the home.   Patricia worked with us on training tasks which have been really effective in helping Alfie and us to feel more confident.  She also correctly identified that Alfie would be much happier eating different food, something which we would never have thought of, without her help.  We would definitely recommend Positive Dog London.  Thank you so much for your help Patricia.

When our previously always sweet 1-year-old dog started exhibiting aggressive and erratic behaviours, we quickly realised we were out of our depth with his training. After extensive research we ended up reaching out to Positive Dog London.  Pat very quickly identified that his aggression was due to underlying medical issues which we wouldn’t have been able to catch without a professional eye. A vet later confirmed he’s been in pain. The support we’ve received since starting our plan has been invaluable and really helped us navigate the situation effectively and not feel alone in this difficult time. Pat is extremely responsive and getting support in real time is something we really appreciated whenever a tricky situation arose. With a proper treatment plan and Pat’s pointers, we started noticing  improvement very quickly. Pat is extremely empathetic, knowledgeable and professional - we couldn’t recommend her more.

Pat has been brilliant. A very knowledgeable behaviourist and trainer. She has helped a lot my nervous rescue dog overcome a lot of her stress and fears. She's also helped and guided me through structured training and plans. The team is also great, accommodating busy schedules and my dogs moods. Highly recommend

Patricia has been brilliant, we have seen lots of progress so far with our extremely nervous rescue dog. She has been adaptable to ours and our dog's needs. We are excited to continue working with her.

Have worked with Pat for over a year now and she's been great. Clearly knowledgable as a behaviourist and has helped our very scared and difficult rescue dog progress leaps and bounds. Sessions are flexible either in person or remote depending on what we're trying to work on. The team is always very responsive to queries and follow up advice. I don't know what we would have done without her!
Great training! We’ve been able to leave our pup after years of separation anxiety. Definitely recommend.
Great training that has really transformed our lovely dog's separation anxiety. Recommend!

Pat has been an absolute game changer for our family. She’s been incredible support as we made our new rescue comfortable at home and we’ve seen him go from a fearful and anxious pup to a confident and playful one. Pat has a very clearly articulated perspective on how she approaches dog behaviour’s and we’ve learned so much in the months we’ve worked with her. Highly recommend!

Best Positive Reinforcement Dog behaviourist  & trainer in London! Incredibly knowledgeable, very patient and kind to everyone. Super understanding of anyone’s situation and will help you to achieve your goals going even above and beyond to help out! 10/10 recommend

I have had some amazing results for all of my dogs. Pat has resolved every kind of issue and i have learned so much from her which has been invaluable.  I would recommend positive dog london to anyone who has a dog, even if they live abroad.

I worked with Pat over 6 months last year with Talia and she was incredible. Not only was she an amazing trainer/behaviouralist, but she has become a close friend. The support she provided was invaluable, her patience impressive and her love for dogs clear.  She was also an incredible emotional support and guide through the process of having to put her down so I cannot recommend her and Leo enough. As my Dad used to say: they are like queer eye for dogs

Pat and her team were absolutely fantastic. Her knowledgeable and empathic approach to working with us and our dog Sprout really helped us understand  Sprout’s behaviour so much more. This in turn helped with our training. She did thorough pain investigations and gave so much time and attention to our training, offering us advice every step of the way. Can’t recommend Pat and her team enough!

I contacted Pat because my dog Reggie had started having some behavioural issues. We'd recently found out he has hip dysplasia and as a result had started becoming quite reactive to other dogs which was a new challenge for us. We worked with Pat on this and within a couple of months his behaviour had improved significantly. We went from not being able to walk down the road without him kicking off to going back to taking him to pubs and cafes and not worrying all the time about it. There will always be a bit of work to do here to ensure he stays like this but we're so grateful to Pat and her kind methods for helping us through this tricky patch with Reggie :)

We had the pleasure of working with Positive Dog Support for over a year, and we can’t recommend Pat enough! She has been incredibly kind, supportive, and knowledgeable throughout our journey.

Before meeting Pat, we had worked with two other dog trainers, but no one could pinpoint what was wrong with our pup, Whoopi. In just minutes of seeing her, Pat made a spot-on diagnosis—Whoopi was in pain. Thanks to her guidance, referrals, and unwavering support, we were able to find the right treatment and stabilize Whoopi.

Pat went above and beyond for us, always available to answer questions, offer reassurance, and simply listen when we needed it most. Her patience, expertise, and dedication make her an outstanding trainer. We’re beyond grateful for her help and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend her to anyone in need of expert dog training and care.

As new dog parents, we learned so much and really appreciate Pat's style of understanding the doggos.

My experience with this company has been extremely disappointing and upsetting.

I registered for the puppy class and have been disappointed by the professionalism, organization and lack of fairness Patrícia has demonstrated.

Upon registration - I received an email requesting some information for a consultation. Shortly after this email I received an email directly from Patricia saying that her automatic email was completely wrong.

This should have been a clear red flag and indication as to how things would continue to be handled but was trying to give it the benefit of the doubt.

Prior to the class - I received an email reminder stating ‘1 day until class’. This again was completely incorrect (it was not 1 day until the class) and lead to great confusion. This again happened the following week.

Just before the class - a different reminder email was sent out - that again had the wrong day countdown on it and the subject title was ‘Can’t’. Literally just this word. I don’t know what went wrong there.

Honestly - I have never seen such unprofessional, incomplete, inaccurate communications being sent from a business.

The class itself was extremely disorganized. They did not have a nice area set up or any real designated area for the training to take place.
There really was no structure to the class itself. My puppy would continue to stop the activity and wanted to go roll in the grass and they encouraged this. They told me that this was fine and to give my puppy treats because my puppy was ‘regulating themself’. They said that I could just practice the activities at home where there were less distractions.

If this is the kind of teaching I wanted - I would have purchased an online training plan. And I would STRONGLY suggest that over paying for this.

In the few moments my puppy was practicing the commands - the teachers were more interested in trying to video (I think) on their phones.

After this 1st class - I did contact Patricia via email directly and expressed my extreme dissatisfaction included above. I explained that this was not the level of professionalism or training I was paying to receive and I requested a refund for the classes I had not yet attended.

She has fully refused and explained her T&C’s explain that if I have attended any class - no refund will be given.
Again I outlined my dissatisfaction for the service she provided and again requested this refund as a fair settlement.

She has confirmed she will not be providing any refund to me.

I can not stress enough how much I feel this was the biggest waste of money and how ridiculously unfair this experience has been.

I would NEVER recommend this business to anyone looking for a respectable, legitimate, professional dog / puppy training business.

Great first session. Patricia knows her stuff and her observations and advice are good and easily understood. Wasn't expecting so much doggy homework, but all very useful! Have signed up for a package
